method.d_gap: maximum adjacent token-bearing SSE event arrival interval over each complete D request, in ms
method.p95: linear interpolation at (n-1)*0.95 after pooling all measured requests in six rounds
method.p_ttft: actual request dispatch to first token-bearing SSE arrival, in ms
method.selection: native16k and guard-v2 initial/confirm; three measured repeats per phase; warmups excluded
method.throughput: sum of D+P output tokens / sum of complete measured window durations
method.validation: whole archive and 12 member hashes; raw SSE hash and event payload sequence; one token per event; prompt IDs, output IDs/counts, usage and transport
